request.description:
Create a non-empty file or overwrite an existing file.

If the parent folder of the `path` parameter doesn't exist, the file system creates it before creating the file.

This acts on files in the AI Hub filesystem, not your local filesystem.

Ensure the path is accessible within the context defined by the `IB-Context` header.

Not all filesystem types support this operation.

| Filesystem | Supported |
|----------------------|-----------|
| Instabase | ✓ |
| Amazon S3 | ✓ |
| Azure Blob Storage | ✓ |
| Google Cloud Storage | ✓ |
| Google Drive | - |

response.name: The request succeeded and a new file was created at the target location. AI Hub returns this status code only when the request includes an `If-None-Match` header with a value of `*`.

request.description:
Read metadata of a file or folder at the target path.

This API operation reports whether the object at the target path is a file or folder. If a file, it also reports the file size and last modification time.

This acts on files and folders in the AI Hub filesystem, not your local filesystem.

Ensure the path is accessible within the context defined by the `IB-Context` header.

Configures retry logic if no file or folder is found at the target path. Uses a constant backoff algorithm. Don't retry if this header isn't provided. Example: `{'retries': 3, 'backoff-seconds': 5}`
Added as a part of security scheme: bearer

request.description:
Delete a single file or folder.

This operation is also available via the SDK method `client.files.delete()`.

This acts on files in the AI Hub filesystem, not your local filesystem.

Ensure the path is accessible within the context defined by the `IB-Context` header.

Not all filesystem types support this operation.

| Filesystem | Supported |
|----------------------|-----------|
| Instabase | ✓ |
| Amazon S3 | ✓ |
| Azure Blob Storage | ✓ |
| Google Cloud Storage | ✓ |
| Google Drive | - |

response.name:
Indicates that the deletion request has been accepted.
The operation returns this status code regardless of whether the file or folder exists.
